computational_target.reason: online work composes a small number of calibrated mode maps; expensive fixed-Q rates and roots occur offline only

cycle_map.periodic_cycle: solve P(q_star)-q_star=0 and assess eigenvalues of DP(q_star)
cycle_map.poincare_map: P=M_recovery o M_cooling o M_hot o M_transition o M_cold

events.memory: the pair (sigma,phi), not q alone, distinguishes hysteretic states

offline_calibration.local_hidden_rank: adaptive; rank 4 is certified for the observed post-transition window
offline_calibration.slow_anchor_interpolation: conservative interpolation of T_sigma, Delta_q_sigma, event surfaces, and phase tables across prospectively selected q anchors
offline_calibration.validation: held-out anchors plus one independent full-cycle or event-to-event truth trajectory

online_state.continuous: q in R^82 plus scalar phase phi in [0,1]
online_state.discrete: mode sigma in {cold, transition, post-transition, hot, cooling, recovery}

within_mode_equations.fixed_Q_limit_used_here: epsilon G_sigma=0 and omega_sigma partial_phi Y_sigma = F_fixedQ(Y_sigma;q)
within_mode_equations.offline_invariance_residual: D_q Y_sigma G_sigma + omega_sigma partial_phi Y_sigma - F(Y_sigma;q)
